title: Roman gods on mission patches for 'our sponsors'

tellings.quote: They're using the images of Roman gods, and I would ask him. I said, "Why are you using images of Roman gods? Why are you putting them on your mission patches and also utilizing Latin phrases from that time period? I mean, you're sending it up in the space. Who up in space is going to read Latin?" And his answer was, "Our sponsors."

plain: A researcher who is not named says, on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, that the US space program puts images of Roman gods and old Latin phrases on its mission patches, the cloth badges made for each space mission. He says he asked a man involved why they did this, since no one up in space would read Latin, and the man answered, "Our sponsors." The story gets told because it hints that someone beyond Earth is the intended audience.
